name: Supergood Store
how_menu_is_reached: Chain home has a store picker and per-store pages such as /store/supergood-des-plaines/. The resolver saved 7 Dutchie embeds from the chain (Grand Haven, Pentwater, New Buffalo, Ravenna, ...).
branch_selection: Des Plaines store page exists. Which embed belongs to it was not isolated.
product_count: Baseline COUNT_MISMATCH at 1557 and 1104; sampler 1038 items.
why_it_fails: Chain-wide embed set: the resolver attached embeds from other Supergood branches. Branch checks reject four attempts (BRANCH_MISMATCH) and two counts fail reconciliation (COUNT_MISMATCH). The Des Plaines embed was never taken from its own store page.
fix_idea: Scope resolution to the Des Plaines store page: take its embed and address, then reconcile the Dutchie total.
unverified: which embed id is Des Plaines
method: Manual browser check (installed Chrome probe and Google/Bing search); pipeline data read-only from terpscout.db; sample run with scripts/sample_stores.py --pages 1.
